**Pakistan: how applications changed.** The extract records 905,863 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 68,777 in 2015, compared with 46,126 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 0.8% higher than in 2019 (45,739). Applications in 2025 were 13% lower than in 2024 (53,168). In 2025, the leading destinations were United Kingdom (10,951; 24%), Italy (10,160; 22%), Canada (4,255; 9.2%). United Kingdom received 24% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 6.8% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 27%, across 45,507 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 16% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 3.2 percentage points lower than in 2024 (31%).
